heldout_rows.question: What are the weaknesses of SearchFlow's competitor products?
heldout_rows.final_text:
These are Slack messages from SearchFlow team channels, all in the herb-searchflow collection. The whole set appears twice, so there are 10 distinct messages.

**Bugs and performance**
- Two team members (eid_4afd9484 in bug-emmajones and eid_3bcf2a20 in bug-georgebrown) shared open-source bugs similar to SearchFlow's own issues, to see what the team could learn from them.
- eid_bed67c52 said several customers were reporting SearchFlow problems and proposed going through them one by one.
- One reported bug, "Overfitting to Frequent Queries," is about the AI model being tuned too heavily for common queries, which hurts search accuracy. It affects the AI Model & Search Algorithm and was reported by customer CUST-0055. It was assigned to eid_de315467.
- eid_de315467 reported that the "Inefficient Query Optimization" bug is fixed, in approved PR https://github.com/salesforce/SearchFlow/pull/51.
- eid_320cd970 noticed search was slower than usual and asked whether the new ranking algorithm was the cause.
- eid_e214d622 said they hadn't known about these issues during development. The architecture was tested, but some edge cases may have been missed.

**Competitors**
- eid_95f6d01c pointed out two weaknesses in competitor SlackSense: high computing demands that slow it down at peak usage, and a complicated initial setup. Teams wanting a quick integration might choose something else because of these.
- eid_ae1d94d2 said MeiliSearch's focus on performance could be useful to SearchFlow and suggested that Alice look at how they implemented it for strategies to adopt.

**Dates:** The source lines give no publication dates. The "indexed 2026-11-05" date only shows when nexus last indexed these messages, not when they were written.
